fee_notes: $50,000 uniform fee for individual restaurant. Development Agreement: 100% of IFF for first restaurant + 50% of IFF for each additional. Military veteran 10% discount on first restaurant. Opening inventory of Hooters Hot Sauce and Seasoning Salt from affiliate: $100-$250.
raw_excerpt: For each individual Hooters Restaurant the Initial Franchise Fee is $50,000. You must pay the entire Initial Franchise Fee for each Hooters Restaurant in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement. This Initial Franchise Fee is uniform for all franchisees.
